title: Lotus Dashboard Creator
shortDescription: Twenty widgets on one screen, in one HTML file. Drag, resize and arrange it the way you work, and your dashboard saves itself into the file you keep.

pricing.note: MIT licensed and free on GitHub. itch can take donations; the file stays free either way.

refundPolicy: Nothing to refund: the download is free.

screenshots.caption: The dashboard as it opens: a six-panel starter with the clock, weather, quick links, tasks, a calendar and notes.
The Add widget panel: twenty widgets, a live preview of each, and the size you want to drop it at.
Seven themes in light and dark, and a contrast solver for the colours you pick yourself.
The first-run welcome, which explains where your dashboard is kept. Press ? to bring it back at any time.
The same workspace in the light theme.
